description: Hourly Agent Introspection pipeline health in the selected display range.
title: Agent Introspection Health

widgets.description: Current pipeline state from the latest completed scan in the selected display range.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  argMax(
    multiIf(
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'succeeded', 'Succeeded',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'no_data', 'No data',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'failed', 'Failed',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'healthy', 'Healthy',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'degraded', 'Degraded',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state'] = 'unhealthy', 'Unhealthy',
    attributes_string['pipeline.state']
  ),
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  ) AS `Pipeline state`,
  formatDateTime(
    max(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)),
    '%d %b %H:%i'
  ) AS `Last completed scan`,
  concat(
    toString(round(argMax(
      attributes_number['scan.duration_ms'],
      tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
    ) / 1000, 2)),
    ' s'
  ) AS `Last scan duration`
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.pipeline.snapshot'
HAVING count() > 0

widgets.title: Pipeline health

widgets.description: Up to 24 completed scans in the selected display range, newest first.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  formatDateTime(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), '%d %b %H:%i') AS `Started at`,
  concat(
    toString(round(toFloat64(attributes_number['scan.duration_ms']) / 1000, 2)),
    ' s'
  ) AS `Duration`,
  multiIf(
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'succeeded', 'Succeeded',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'no_data', 'No data',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'failed', 'Failed',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'healthy', 'Healthy',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'degraded', 'Degraded',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status'] = 'unhealthy', 'Unhealthy',
    attributes_string['scan.terminal_status']
  ) AS `Outcome`,
  toFloat64(attributes_number['rows.processed']) AS `Rows processed`
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.pipeline.snapshot'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 24
